title: Flood (simulation)
disclaimer: Simplified, indicative simulation run in your browser — not a certified hydraulic study. Nothing about the model leaves this device.
unsupported: This browser cannot run the simulation: it needs WebGPU, or WebGL 2 with float render targets.

ground.title: Ground
ground.order: Used in this order: the IFC's own terrain, an imported DEM, the map's relief, and the remaining holes filled from their neighbours.
ground.mapOff: Turn on the map with relief to use its terrain

buildings.title: Buildings
buildings.mapOff: Turn on the map to include the surrounding buildings

rain.title: Rain
rain.facts: {{mm}} mm over {{min}} min, peaking near {{peak}} mm/h. Uniform over the area.

stage.raster: Drawing the plan view on the GPU…

report.title: What the simulation sees
report.coarsened: The area is large for this cell size: cells widened to {{dx}} m.
report.planeWarn: No terrain data here: the ground is a plane at Y = {{y}} m. Import a DEM or turn on the map with relief for a real one.
report.coarseDem: The map's relief here comes from the global mosaic (≈30 m data): it does not see streets or kerbs. An imported DEM gives a better result.

demNote.reprojected: The DEM was reprojected to the model's coordinate system.
demNote.sameCrs: The DEM is in the model's coordinate system.
demNote.assumedSameCrs: The DEM states no coordinate system (or the model does not): it is assumed to be the model's.
demNote.noHeightDatum: The model states no height datum: the DEM was stood on the project's ground floor under the model.
demNote.notGeoreferenced: The model is not georeferenced, so the DEM cannot be placed. Georeference it in the Map panel.
demNote.outside: The DEM does not cover the simulation area.

hyeto.label: Rain intensity per interval: press and drag to draw it

timeline.label: Flood timeline
timeline.probeHint: Click the scene to read the water there (Esc to stop)

probe.title: Probe
probe.hint: Click the scene to read the water at that point.
probe.obstacle: Inside an obstacle (a building): water does not enter here.

affected.title: Flood: elements reached
affected.summary: Below the highest water next to them: {{n}} of the {{checked}} elements checked.
affected.none: None of the {{checked}} elements checked (doors, windows, accesses, spaces, equipment) sits below the highest water next to it.
affected.partial: Maxima so far ({{t}}): the run has not finished.
affected.pending: Listed when the run finishes: doors, windows, accesses, spaces and equipment below the highest water.
affected.belowNote: Their bottom is below the ground outside (basements, sunken accesses). The figure is the water standing outside; whether it gets in depends on openings the simulation does not model.
affected.jump: Select it and fly to it
affected.note: Indicative: the water standing outside each element against its lowest point. Not part of the validation result or the Health Score.

export.title: Export
export.videoNeedsEnd: The video is available once the run has finished.
export.rasterNote: GIS files of the whole grid, north up; buildings are no-data. Depth in m, speed in m/s, arrival in s.
export.local: The model is not georeferenced: the file uses its local plan coordinates (metres), with no coordinate system.

capture.disclaimer: Simplified, indicative simulation: not a certified hydraulic study.
